name: ShenZhen Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: ShenZhen Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides electrical and mechanical insulations solutions in China and internationally. It operates through five segments: Electronic Materials, Communication Cables, Power, New Energy, and Wind Power Generation. The company offers heat shrinkable sleeves, busbar tubes, and cable accessories; cable branch boxes; ring network cabinets; high and low voltage switchgears; WQFB fully insulated closed busbar tubes; environmentally friendly high temperature silicone wires; high-temperature resistant PTFE casings; conductor connecting pipes; heat shrinkable composite double-wall pipes; silicone rubber pipes; PTFE casings…
